_readme: Curated research on every significant building surrounding Union on 24th (701 W 24th St). Used by scripts/fetch_reference_imagery.py to download reference images, and by the desktop image-analysis workflow. true_height_m is the best real-world estimate; snapshot_height_m is what the baked 2026-07-11 data says (LiDAR flights predate the new towers, so several are badly wrong). confidence: high = multiple corroborating sources, med = single source or inferred, low = candidate/uncertain.
